mapper.select: SELECT r.REPORT_ID AS reportId, r.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, u1.NICKNAME AS reporterNickname, u2.NICKNAME AS targetNickname, tp.TITLE AS placeTitle, r.REPORT_TYPE AS reportType, r.REASON AS reason, r.STATUS AS status, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REPORT r JOIN USERS u1 ON r.USER_ID = u1.NO JOIN REVIEW rv ON r.REVIEW_ID = rv.REVIEW_ID JOIN USERS u2 ON rv.USER_ID = u2.NO JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON rv.CONTENT_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REPORT_ID AS reportId, r.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, u1.NICKNAME AS reporterNickname, u2.NICKNAME AS targetNickname, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.STATUS AS status, r.HANDLED_AT AS handledAt, r.REPORT_TYPE AS reportType, r.REASON AS reason, rv.CONTENT AS reviewContent, rv.REVIEW_IMAGE AS reviewImage FROM REPORT r JOIN USERS u1 ON r.USER_ID = u1.NO JOIN REVIEW rv ON r.REVIEW_ID = rv.REVIEW_ID JOIN USERS u2 ON rv.USER_ID = u2.NO WHERE r.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
